decisions.reason: After several years, the learning value of this distant niche has largely been realized, and for a large lighting firm the resources are better redirected to stronger core LED and maritime-adjacent opportunities.
This line is a strong adjacent fit with the firm's industrial customers and engineering capabilities, so its option value remains high and the case for withdrawal is weak.

As a close-to-core and previously popular product, it still merits retention as a complementary offering, although its mature and more design-led position makes it less protected than core industrial lines.

A pendant office luminaire fits directly with the firm's commercial building solutions, and in a growing, innovative market the product should be kept while its medium-term value continues to prove out.
This premium pendant range is close to the established offer and the multi-model investment suggests scalable potential, so keeping the option open is more attractive than exiting now.
